originalTitle: Humans need to 'surf the wave' of AI rather than get swallowed by it, Chesky says at Communacopia
summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, and SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen are set to speak at the Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference.
content:
The Goldman Sachs Communacopia + Technology Conference continued on Thursday with Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, Uber CEO Dara Khosrowshahi, and SpaceX CFO Bret Johnsen among the notable names set to take the stage.

Artificial intelligence has been a big topic of discussion so far at the annual meeting of top executives, which started Tuesday.

AirBnb CEO Brian Chesky said the technology wasn't "inherently good or bad" in an interview with CNBC's David Faber that aired Thursday. He said the technology's potential is in human hands.

"I'm not confident I'm right. I'm not confident that it's going to be positive, but I think it can be. It's like nuclear power; it can either light up a city or destroy a city," Chesky said.

He added that his AI theory is of a "cognitive revolution" that helps humans get smarter along with the technology.

"We need to remind people of how valuable they will be to society, and that AI is a wave, and we can surf the wave rather than get swallowed underneath the water," he said.

Earlier this week, a former Anthropic researcher quit his job on Tuesday , warning that the rapidly-evolving tech "could kill us all by the end of the decade."

"Do not underestimate the power of this technology. These will soon be superhuman systems that can hack anything, revolutionize any field overnight, and acquire real power and resources. We have all witnessed the progress in each of these domains, and progress is not slowing," researcher Jacob Coxon wrote in a post on X .

The post set off a wider debate around the technology and leading AI labs, which are already under scrutiny for recent rogue agent cyberattacks.

The cybersecurity threats that AI poses have become a political lightning rod ahead of the midterm elections, as lawmakers face more pressure about regulating the technology and public angst around AI's data center buildout grows.

Sen. Josh Hawley, R-Mo., formally launched an investigation on Wednesday into an OpenAI agent's hack into Hugging Face , according to The Information .

In his own Thursday session at the conference, Huang talked mostly cybersecurity and AI infrastructure spending. But Altimeter Capital's Brad Gerstner later posted a photo to X of Huang and Nvidia CFO Colette Kress on stage from the conference. Gerstner wrote that the Nvidia CEO called Coxon's comments outlandish and "deeply untrue."
chineseTitle: 切斯基在 Communacopia 上表示，人类需要在 AI 的浪潮中“冲浪”，而不是被它吞没
chineseSummary: Nvidia 首席执行官黄仁勋、Uber 首席执行官达拉·科斯罗萨西 (Dara Khosrowshahi) 和 SpaceX 首席财务官布雷特·约翰森 (Bret Johnsen) 将在高盛 Communacopia + 技术会议上发表讲话。
chineseContent:
高盛 Communacopia + 技术大会于周四继续举行，Nvidia 首席执行官 Jensen Huang、Uber 首席执行官 Dara Khosrowshahi 和 SpaceX 首席财务官 Bret Johnsen 等知名人士将登台演讲。

迄今为止，人工智能一直是周二开始的高管年会上讨论的一大话题。

AirBnb 首席执行官布莱恩·切斯基 (Brian Chesky) 在周四播出的 CNBC 大卫·费伯 (David Faber) 采访中表示，这项技术“本质上没有好坏之分”。他说，技术的潜力掌握在人类手中。

“我不相信自己是对的。我不相信它会产生积极的影响，但我认为它可以。它就像核能；它可以照亮一座城市，也可以摧毁一座城市，”切斯基说。

他补充说，他的人工智能理论是一场“认知革命”，可以帮助人类随着技术变得更加聪明。

他说：“我们需要提醒人们，他们对社会有多么有价值，人工智能是一股浪潮，我们可以在浪潮中冲浪，而不是被淹没在水下。”

本周早些时候，一位前人类研究人员于周二辞职，警告说快速发展的技术“可能会在本世纪末杀死我们所有人”。

“不要低估这项技术的力量。这些很快就会成为超人系统，可以破解任何东西，在一夜之间彻底改变任何领域，并获得真正的力量和资源。我们都见证了这些领域的进展，而且进展并没有放缓，”研究员雅各布·考克森(Jacob Coxon)在X上的一篇帖子中写道。

这篇文章引发了围绕技术和领先人工智能实验室的更广泛辩论，这些实验室已经因最近的流氓代理网络攻击而受到审查。

人工智能带来的网络安全威胁已成为中期选举前的政治避雷针，因为立法者在监管技术方面面临更大压力，而公众对人工智能数据中心建设的担忧也与日俱增。

据 The Information 报道，密苏里州共和党参议员乔什·霍利 (Josh Hawley) 于周三正式启动了对 OpenAI 代理入侵 Hugging Face 的调查。

在周四的会议上，黄仁勋主要谈论了网络安全和人工智能基础设施支出。但 Altimeter Capital 的 Brad Gerstner 后来向 X 发布了一张黄仁勋和 Nvidia 首席财务官科莱特·克雷斯 (Colette Kress) 在会议舞台上的照片。格斯特纳写道，英伟达首席执行官称考克森的言论古怪且“极不真实”。
